news.title: Tesla rises 2.2% after hours to $382.15 as Musk confirms SpaceX merger committees
news.summary: Musk said on SpaceX's earnings call that both companies have formed independent special committees to evaluate a merger; no terms are final and a deal would need approval from at least 50% of all outstanding Tesla shares. RBC sketched a hypothetical all-stock deal at $480 a share, and Cantor reiterated Overweight with a $485 target ahead of Wednesday's Q3 report.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review a merger
news.summary: The committees of independent directors were formed at shareholders' request, Musk said, calling the process 'an odd kabuki dance' since he is conflicted and can't take part. He cautioned that a combination is not a certainty and that Tesla shareholders would have to support it.

news.title: Tesla's credit-default-swap spread hits its widest since May 2023 ahead of Q3 results
news.summary: Tesla's five-year CDS spread rose to 188.1 basis points, its highest since May 2023, as the stock fell 7.3% last week despite the flying-Roadster reveal and 486,532 Q3 deliveries. Shares are down more than 18% this year; Q3 results are due after Wednesday's close, with consensus around $28B revenue and $0.45 EPS.

news.title: Tesla closes up 3.8% at $368.06 on SpaceX-deal chatter and the tech rebound
news.summary: Tesla rose from Friday's $354.72 close as investor Gary Black outlined a possible all-stock SpaceX acquisition of Tesla at around $420 a share within weeks and Barclays' Dan Levy flagged a possible announcement before the Dec. 3 annual meeting; neither company has confirmed talks. The Nasdaq's rebound from its worst week since June added to the move two days before Q3 results.

news.title: Tesla proxy asks shareholders to re-elect Musk, Denholm and Straubel; none of the $1T award's tranches earned yet
news.summary: Tesla's proxy for the Dec. 3 annual meeting reports Musk's 2025 performance award of about 423.7M restricted shares at $158.4B in the compensation table; none of its 12 market-cap/operational tranches ($2T–$8.5T) has been earned. It also caps borrowing against Musk's 207.5M pledged shares at the lesser of $3.5B or 25% of their value; Musk owns nearly 20% of Tesla.

news.title: Tesla sets its annual meeting for Dec. 3 as SpaceX merger talk builds ahead of earnings
news.summary: Tesla said Monday its annual meeting will be held Dec. 3. It reports Q3 after the close Wednesday, a day after SpaceX; an adviser who owns both stocks told Reuters auto-margin improvement is the key Tesla metric. Barclays estimates Musk would hold about 37% of the equity and 56% of the votes in an all-stock combination.

news.title: Musk: Optimus and Cybercab will be 'the vast majority of Tesla's value'
news.summary: In a Sunday post Musk said Optimus and Cybercab will account for most of Tesla's worth, naming super intelligence, robots, solar and mass-to-space as the areas that can scale to 'incredible size'; he kept the Roadster in the plan because it is 'super cool.' Tesla reports Q3 after the close on Oct. 21; analysts expect EPS of $0.43 on $27.90B revenue, with auto gross margin and energy-storage margins in focus.

news.title: Tesla slips 2.1% to $354.72 as the Roadster reveal fades before Q3 earnings
news.summary: TSLA opened higher after the Roadster demo but closed down 2.13% on 61.6M shares, about 64% above its three-month average, as the Nasdaq fell 2.15%; analysts largely echoed Gene Munster's 'engineering flex' view, and attention turned to next week's Q3 report. Prediction-market odds of a Tesla–SpaceX deal nearly doubled overnight to 56%.

news.title: Tesla gives back its Roadster pop; JPMorgan stays Neutral with a $415 target
news.summary: TSLA rose to $371.13 premarket, then sold off below its open; the piece put the stock down about 8% for the week and 23% year to date, noted JPMorgan kept its Neutral rating and $415 target, and flagged the Oct. 21 earnings report as the next test.

news.title: Tesla unveils a thruster-equipped Roadster with SpaceX; production slated for 2028; shares up ~5% premarket
news.summary: The two-seater (0-60 mph in under a second, 230+ mph top speed, 300+ miles of range) jumped over vehicles using SpaceX-built thrusters; reservations require $50,000 (Performance) or $250,000 (Thrust) deposits, with no prices given. TSLA closed down 1.3% at $362.44 before the event, then rose about 5% in Friday premarket trading. Q3 results are due Oct. 21.

news.title: Tesla slides 2.1% to $367 on the hot September CPI, a week before Q3 earnings
news.summary: No Tesla-specific catalyst: September CPI ran 3.7% year over year (3.6% expected), lifting odds of a Fed hike at the Oct. 27-28 meeting and dragging big tech lower. TSLA closed at $367.16, about 4% below its Oct. 9 close. The Roadster event streams Thursday, Oct. 15, and Q3 results come after the close Oct. 21.

news.title: Tesla slips 0.7% on light volume as BNP Paribas flags $25B+ spending
news.summary: TSLA closed at $375.23 on volume about half its average, with no single company event behind the dip. Coverage centered on BNP Paribas's cash-burn concerns over capex above $25B; Tesla's Robotaxi account said its Austin fleet passed 300 Cybercabs. Q3 results come after the close Oct. 21.
